보강하고 다시 테스트해줘.

baseline_prompt_en: A quiet, physically convincing photograph in a photographic conservation room. A woman guided by the supplied portrait is confronting evidence beyond human understanding. Use the supplied portrait as face and hair appearance guidance. Keep her delicate oval facial proportions, large dark-brown eyes and softly shaped lips; her chin-length dark bob and fine wispy fringe retain their particular shape. Her individual warmth remains present in the close, soft light on her face, now interrupted by dawning alarm. She sits at a low workbench beside a recovered glass photographic plate, roughly thirty by forty centimetres, standing vertically in a narrow padded conservation rack. Her left fingertips steady its lower side edge while her right hand has stopped halfway through drawing away a translucent interleaving sheet. Both forearms emerge clearly from the sleeves of a loosely draped ivory blouse; her elbows remain close to her torso. The sheet curls onto the table, revealing a clean lower section of the image against the still-veiled upper section. Her gaze is fixed on that newly exposed boundary, lips slightly parted and shoulders held still. It is the moment when an ordinary examination becomes cosmic dread before an ancient indifferent reality. Inside the silver-black emulsion, a recognizable strip of coastal cliffs and a minute lighthouse sits beneath an immense curving built surface. The lighthouse is a pin against uninterrupted mineral masonry that sweeps out of the recorded frame; deep openings cross its weathered facets at incompatible angles. Bands of encrusted sediment run continuously across the structure, making it feel discovered beneath an age of stone rather than newly constructed. The most consequential extent remains outside the glass image. The crisp edge of the fragile plate, the tiny familiar coastline and her stopped hand give the impossible scale a physical comparison. Frame her face on the left and the upright plate on the right, each large enough to read together, with their near edges in the same shallow working plane. An angled desk lamp makes the emulsion legible while a faint window reflection catches only the outer glass rim. Keep the room's closed archival boxes soft and dark behind them. Photograph the scene with restrained colour, believable skin texture, a gentle falloff into the storage room and the stillness of an interrupted task.
